card.title: Jess Wilson vows to bring back hope after election win

children.content: Liberal leader Jess Wilson will become Victoria's first popularly elected female premier as the Coalition dislodges Labor from state government after 12 years.
In her first speech, the 36-year-old promises to govern for all Victorians and immediately begin work to take the state in a fresh direction.
